successors.name: German Africa
successors.text: Unyanyembe, the Nyamwezi kingdom around Tabora (a radius; the pages give no boundary)

ledger.x: Early 1800s: Unyanyembe is one of the Nyamwezi kingdoms.
1871: Unyanyembe goes to war with Mirambo's Urambo.
1884: the war ends with Mirambo's death.

wars.name: Unyanyembe-Urambo war
wars.outcome: Inconclusive: the war 'lasted until Mirambo's death in 1884'; Urambo blockaded the ivory trade from Tabora in 1873.

wars.name: German campaigns against Isike
wars.outcome: German victory in 1893: the first attempt in 1890 failed, the Germans lost half their troops at Kalenga in 1891, two major attacks on Isike failed before 1893, and Isike's death in 1893 ended the resistance.

certainty.note: No boundary is given by the page.
